profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in bulky navy blue plate armor with large rounded spaulders and a matching cape. Features a long crimson tabard and spiky dark red hair secured by a gray headband.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stern masculine face with intense, narrow eyes and sharp features. Framed by thick dark red spiky hair and a wide gray headband.
profile.weapon_desc: Massive silver crescent-bladed poleaxe held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Front-isometric stance facing down-right. Arms at sides, navy armor and red tabard prominently displayed.
profile.step2_windup: Right hand glows with golden energy before reaching back to pull a large poleaxe over the shoulder into a high overhead position.
profile.step3_impact: Deep forward lunge slamming the axe down. A large, vertical cone of bright yellow energy erupts upward from the point of impact.
profile.step4_finish: Stays in a low follow-through crouch with the axe head near the ground as the golden light trail dissipates.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The vertical yellow energy flare in Frame 4 perfectly aligns with the downward overhead trajectory of the poleaxe strike.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence maintains directional consistency and proper wind-up. VFX alignment and frame transitions effectively mirror reference mechanics.
